means.payments.stuck_attempts: started, never confirmed, and older than 30 minutes; a shopper who closed the tab leaves the same row, so watch it for a change rather than reading it as failures
means.integrations.channels.failing_resources: resources that have failed 3 times in a row
means.integrations.channels.late_resources: resources with no success inside this window
means.integrations.carriers.failing_capabiliti: capabilities whose LAST event was a failure; the carrier table keeps no failure counter, so this is a different test from the channels above
means.integrations.carriers.late_capabilities: capabilities with no success inside this window
means.unattributed: rows whose market is not recorded; never counted as the default market
means.payments.reconciliation_breaks: cost reconciliations nobody has settled -- a variance not accepted, an invoice line with no estimate, an estimate with no invoice line. A BACKLOG and not a window: one from last month is still money this platform cannot account for, so this figure does not fall when the window moves
means.issues.open_shop_issues: shop service-level breaches nobody has cleared, counted in the market of the shop they are against. A BACKLOG and not a window. STAFF issues and ESCALATIONS are not in this figure and are not sent at all: this platform keeps no record of either, and a zero would read as "none open"
means.issues.pending_approvals: approval requests nobody has decided, counted in the market of the shop that asked. Also a backlog. A request that names no shop is counted apart rather than placed in a market
